source.symbol: Subscribe server and search label controls
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
<vbox>
          <!-- Server Label and Input Container -->
          <vbox id="serverContainer" flex="1">
            <label
              id="serverlabel"
              data-l10n-id="subscribe-server"
              control="serverMenu"
            ></label>
            <menulist id="serverMenu" flex="1" class="folderMenuItem">
              <menupopup
                is="folder-menupopup"
                mode="subscribe"
                expandFolders="false"
                oncommand="onServerClick(event.target._folder)"
              />
            </menulist>
          </vbox>

          <!-- Name Field Label and Input Container -->
          <vbox id="nameContainer" flex="1">
            <label
              id="namefieldlabel"
              data-l10n-id="subscribe-namefield"
              control="namefield"
            ></label>
            <html:input
              type="search"
              id="namefield"
              class="themeableSearchBox"
              aria-controls="subscribeTree"
              oninput="Search()"
            />
          </vbox>
        </vbox>

        <spacer />
        <separator class="thin" />
